notes: The sender hosts now: Send, pick your files, then 'Start hotspot & send' — this phone makes the hotspot and the other phone just turns on Wi-Fi and joins it. Devices appear live inside the hotspot sheet — tap one to send. With no connection at all, the share sheet leads with 'Turn on hotspot' / 'Join same Wi-Fi'. Receiver side simplified: no hotspot button on Home; Receive with no connection just says 'Turn on Wi-Fi'.
